Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly updated the confirmed death location to “Rancho Palos Verdes, California” despite sources indicating “Palos Verdes/Palos Verdes Estates, California.” This conflated distinct cities on the Palos Verdes Peninsula and contradicted the evidence (e.g., LA Times obituary stating Palos Verdes Estates), introducing a factual error about the place of death.
